'''Pokémon Horizon: Sun & Moon''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター ホライズン''' ''Pocket Monsters Horizon'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] created by '''Tenya Yabuno''' (Japanese: '''やぶのてんや''' ''Yabuno Ten'ya''). 

The manga follows the adventures of a Pokémon Trainer, {{OBP|Akira|Horizon}}, and his {{p|Rockruff}}.
